exposure: Women with pre-pregnant BMI <25.0 kg/m2 and without GDM during the index pregnancy
History of GDM in the index pregnancy
Annual BMI gain during the interpregnancy period
outcome: Risk of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in the subsequent pregnancy
finding: Annual BMI gain during the interpregnancy period was positively associated with GDM risk in the subsequent pregnancy, particularly for women with a pre-pregnancy BMI below 25.0 kg/m2 and no history of GDM.
